curated.notes: Goblin tokens plus a storm shell (Empty the Warrens, Grapeshot, Haze of Rage, Spreading Insurrection are storm payoffs; Battle Hymn, Brightstone Ritual, Seething Song and Mana Geyser the rituals). Forge's STORM plan needs eight cheap rituals and cantrips and the precon has six, so the plan does not fire; the levers left to the heuristic AI are the storm knobs (hold a storm spell until two spells were cast this turn) and the tutor order: Goblin Matron, Goblin Lackey and Conspicuous Snoop fetch Goblins, so the engine Goblins come first. The Storm-Kiln Artist + Haze of Rage pair is Spellbook's; Impact Tremors turns any token burst into damage. Monte Carlo (the mc arms) is where storm sequencing can actually improve.
curated.by: hand, from the decklist and Forge's plan detectors (DESIGN.md §19)

playbook.notes: Zada copies a spell that targets only her for every other creature we control, so the deck's engine is a board of Goblins, Zada, and a one-mana spell aimed at her: Expedite, Crimson Wisps and Renegade Tactics draw a card for each creature, Ancestors' Aid makes a Treasure for each, Fists of Flame and Witch's Mark draw and pump, Wild Ride pumps and gives haste. Stock Forge aims about a third of these at Zada and sits on the rest (DESIGN.md §21), so they are held for the rules, which cast them at Zada in the first main phase once she has two other creatures, draws first and pump last, and never when the copies would draw most of the library (more than twelve creatures, or under forty cards left: a seat decked itself that way in testing). Krenko, Mob Boss makes his tokens every turn before combat instead of attacking, which stock does twice in a hundred games. The permanents go down in the listed order, best first, whatever Forge thinks of them (Faithless Looting is flagged AI:RemoveDeck:All and stock never casts it). Battle Hymn and Brightstone Ritual wait for a hand to spend them on. Haze of Rage is cast before an attack of five or more, at most six times a turn: with Storm-Kiln Artist it is the deck's infinite combo, and stock recasts it for minutes without attacking. Skullclamp goes on a 1/1 Goblin token after combat while no lord keeps it alive; Idol of Oblivion is tapped whenever a token was made; Fountainport does not eat the tokens. The attack is the go-wide policy with the spread: what the first defender does not need to die goes at the next. A land-count mulligan rule was tried and changed nothing (9.61 against 9.56 turns), so the mulligan stays Forge's. Not written yet: Great Train Heist's extra combat, Past in Flames, Goblin Bombardment and the sacrifice outlets, tutor targets.
